notes.title: Patch Notes 07/04/22
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Softlock in tutorial removed
[*] Occlusion issues smoothed out. Performance may be impacted on some machines, but rooms and characters within them should render as expected.
[*] Mouse sensitivity range has been increased
[*] Various sound fixes throughout the game. 
[*] Crafting recipe for small bolt has been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Abermore review
notes.content: In the dead of night, a local busybody comes straight to the door of your flat with gossip. Evidently, there's no Facebook in Abermore. "The puddle's back," he says. This pool of liquid sits on the city's thoroughfares, apparently, and looks normal enough at a glance. But when carriages pass through, it doesn't splash. And while reflective, it never shows an image. Residents suspect it's fathoms deep. Oh: and that anything falling in turns to metal... Read more.

notes.title: Hot Fix 29/03/22
notes.content:
Some quick fixes to try and alleviate some of the issues you have been experiencing:
[list]
[*] Adjusted occlusion settings to prevent rooms loading in an incomplete/incorrect state.
[*] Implemented Key Rebinding
[*] Correct sound cues for certain objects
[/list]

notes.title: Assemble a crew and rip off the king in this new Thief-style stealth adventure
notes.content: The developer of 10 Second Ninja has unveiled a new project called Abermore, a first-person stealth game about a notorious thief named The Unhanged Man who's aiming to commit the heist of the century by busting into the Royal Palace and stealing everything that isn't nailed down... Read more.
